mapper.sql:
WHERE p.active = TRUE
AND CONCAT_WS(' ', p.program_name, p.target_description, p.eligibility_description, p.offering_institution_name, p.handling_institution, p.usage_description, p.support_area, p.interest_rate_type) LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{keyword}, '=', '=='), '%', '=%'), '_', '=_'), '%') ESCAPE '='
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '근로자|직장인|재직자' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '근로자|직장인|재직자')
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '사업자|자영업자' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '사업자|자영업자')
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '소상공인|영세사업자' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '소상공인|영세사업자')
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '청년|대학생|대학원생|취업준비생' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '청년|대학생|대학원생|취업준비생')
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '저소득|저신용|취약계층|차상위|기초생활수급' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '저소득|저신용|취약계층|차상위|기초생활수급')
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '농업인|어업인|농림어업인' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '농업인|어업인|농림어업인')
AND (p.target_description IS NULL OR TRIM(p.target_description) = '' OR p.target_description LIKE '%기타%')
AND p.usage_description LIKE '%창업%'
AND p.usage_description REGEXP '운영|시설|경영|사업'
AND p.usage_description REGEXP '생계|생활'
AND p.usage_description REGEXP '주거|전세|임차|보증금'
AND (p.usage_description REGEXP '대환|전환|고금리' OR p.program_name REGEXP '대환|전환')
AND (p.usage_description REGEXP '학자금|등록금' OR p.program_name LIKE '%학자금%')
AND (p.usage_description IS NULL OR TRIM(p.usage_description) = '' OR p.usage_description LIKE '%기타%')
AND p.max_support_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.max_support_amount < 10000000
AND p.max_support_amount >= 10000000
AND p.max_support_amount >= 30000000
AND p.max_support_amount >= 50000000
AND p.max_support_amount >= 100000000
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '청년|대학생|만 19세|만 34세|만 39세' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '청년|대학생|만 19세|만 34세|만 39세')
AND (p.target_description REGEXP '중장년|중년|장년|만 40세|만 50세|만 60세' OR p.eligibility_description REGEXP '중장년|중년|장년|만 40세|만 50세|만 60세')
AND (p.support_area LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') OR p.eligibility_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM policy_support_program p
ORDER BY p.policy_support_program_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_support_program ( external_seq, program_name, target_description, max_support_amount, min_interest_rate, max_interest_rate, interest_rate_type, interest_rate_description, support_period_description, repayment_method, usage_description, institution_category, offering_institution_name, handling_institution, support_area, eligibility_description, application_method, contact_description, application_url, operation_period, eligibility_json, effective_from, effective_to, active ) VALUES ( #{externalSeq}, #{programName}, #{targetDescription}, #{maxSupportAmount}, #{minInterestRate}, #{maxInterestRate}, #{interestRateType}, #{interestRateDescription}, #{supportPeriodDescription}, #{repaymentMethod}, #{usageDescription}, #{institutionCategory}, #{offeringInstitutionName}, #{handlingInstitution}, #{supportArea}, #{eligibilityDescription}, #{applicationMethod}, #{contactDescription}, #{applicationUrl}, #{operationPeriod}, #{eligibilityJson}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{active} )
mapper.update: UPDATE policy_support_program SET program_name = #{programName}, target_description = #{targetDescription}, max_support_amount = #{maxSupportAmount}, min_interest_rate = #{minInterestRate}, max_interest_rate = #{maxInterestRate}, interest_rate_type = #{interestRateType}, interest_rate_description = #{interestRateDescription}, support_period_description = #{supportPeriodDescription}, repayment_method = #{repaymentMethod}, usage_description = #{usageDescription}, institution_category = #{institutionCategory}, offering_institution_name = #{offeringInstitutionName}, handling_institution = #{handlingInstitution}, support_area = #{supportArea}, eligibility_description = #{eligibilityDescription}, application_method = #{applicationMethod}, contact_description = #{contactDescription}, application_url = #{applicationUrl}, operation_period = #{operationPeriod}, eligibility_json = #{eligibilityJson}, effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, effective_to = #{effectiveTo}, active = #{active} WHERE policy_support_program_id = #{policySupportProgramId}
